full.description: This image is a transmission electron micrograph of cardiac muscle tissue, specifically showing the myocardium of the heart. The ultrastructure displays distinct myofibrils and specialized membrane structures labeled as 'Triads', which are characteristic of cardiac muscle cells. These triads consist of a T-tubule paired with terminal cisternae of the sarcoplasmic reticulum. The level of detail reflects high-resolution ultrastructural analysis of myocardial tissue.
